The General Overseer of the Redeemed Christian Church of God, Pastor Enoch Adeboye, and his wife, Pastor Folu Adeboye, have attended the wedding of their granddaughter, Oluwafunmilayo Adubi, in Baltimore, Maryland, United States. Oluwafunmilayo married David Joseph at House of Praise Baltimore on October 21, 2026. The ceremony drew family members, senior RCCG leaders and other guests, with the cleric offering a special prayer and marriage blessing for the newlyweds. Footage from the ceremony shared online on Friday showed Adeboye stepping forward to pray for the couple, in a moment that attracted attention on social media. The bride is the daughter of Pastor Bolu Adubi, Adeboye’s only daughter, and her husband, Pastor Akinsanya Adubi. At the ceremony, Bolu personally handed her daughter over in marriage. In a post celebrating the bride, Ogunjimi wrote, “It’s all about Oluwafunmilayo, the graceful granddaughter of Pastor E A Adeboye, the General Overseer of The Redeemed Christian Church of God. The union is greatly blessed.” In another post, the MC wrote, “Great Grandparents loading. Congratulations Daddy & MGO” The post celebrated the couple’s union and featured Adeboye and his wife, whom many members of the church affectionately call Daddy G.O. and Mummy G.O. The wedding has since drawn attention online, particularly following the circulation of footage showing the RCCG leader praying for his granddaughter and her husband.
